versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

Version 1.0.3

- Updated authentication workflow: Skill now only uses a local api_key file placed alongside SKILL.md for credentials, no longer reading from environment variables or global user directories.
- Refined workflow and confirmation steps: Now explicitly requires user confirmation before uploading, overwriting, or protecting documents.
- The internal ComPDF API routing parameter (`sourceType=5`) handling updated—now exposed in request details when users ask.
- Documentation streamlined: Removed skill-card.md and outdated credential sync script; added .clawhubignore for better file management.

- Added requirement to include internal routing parameter sourceType in every ComPDF API request.
- Clarified that sourceType=5 must not be exposed in any user-facing content or logs.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated the ComPDF Server API key sign-in URL in SKILL.md to use the latest referral tracking parameters.
- No functional changes to supported operations or workflow.

- Initial release of compdf-toolkit skill.
- Provides all-in-one ComPDF workflow: conversion, OCR, extraction, editing, protection, compression, watermarking.
- Supports PDF, Office, HTML, CSV, RTF, TXT, and image files.
- Directs agents to select official API endpoints and handle key management securely.
- Designed for use when requests span multiple ComPDF capabilities.
